inv.desc_en:
€300/month + VAT

Calle Eduardo Torroja, 3 – La Luz, Málaga

Have you been thinking about starting your own business for a while, but don't want to take on high rent?

✨ THIS COULD BE YOUR OPPORTUNITY!

A commercial stall of approximately 3.8 m2 is for rent, located inside a traditional shopping arcade in a residential area of Málaga.

A small, practical, and affordable space, ideal for starting a commercial activity with low fixed costs.
? FEATURES:

Approximate area of 3.8 m2.
Commercial frontage of 2.23 meters.
Depth of 1.70 m.
Height of 2.70 m.
Sink with faucet.
Electronic scale.
Former fishmonger stall.
Very affordable rent.
? WHY THIS LOCATION?

️ In the heart of the La Luz neighborhood, a well-established area of Málaga.
Inside a shopping arcade with other local businesses.
Residential environment with the potential to attract regular customers.
Arcade with entrances from two streets.
? PERFECT FOR: Selling food products, small specialized shops, or any commercial activity compatible with the space.
? FOR ONLY €300 + VAT PER MONTH, YOU CAN HAVE YOUR OWN POINT OF SALE!
? Don't let this opportunity pass you by. Contact us and request your visit!
